No Meta MBA Product Manager intern posting found for 2026 or 2027. The only MBA product-adjacent intern role found is 'Product Marketing Manager Intern, MBA' (San Francisco, 12 weeks; https://themuse.com/jobs/meta/product-marketing-manager-intern-mba-1c0709), which is out of scope. Meta's RPM program targets new grads/undergrads. Generic Meta intern pay bands ($7,188-$12,134/month plus ~$2,600/mo housing, per Extern, a third-party guide) are not PM/MBA-specific. Low confidence either way; worth asking Wharton's Tech club whether Meta hires MBA PM interns.
